meta.name: n8n-workflow-builder
meta.description: Build automation workflows with n8n for game dev tasks. Use when automating repetitive processes, setting up notifications, scheduling backups, or connecting services. Reduces manual overhead that ADHD brains find hardest to maintain.

copy.tagline: 自动化游戏开发中的重复流程与通知
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果游戏开发中常被重复操作拖累。
copy.tagline_en: Automate repetitive game dev tasks like notifications and backups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a game developer drowning in repetitive manual chores.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你按 n8n 的方式把重复任务自动化:先判断是否值得做,再给出一个简单工作流设计,并提醒你用凭据系统、先测试、导出 JSON 备份。
howto.when: 当你说要自动化重复流程、设置通知或定时备份等时触发;它也会在你手动做需要重复的操作时主动建议改用工作流。

say.text: 帮我把游戏项目每天 2 点备份到 MinIO。
say.note: 它会按 5 分钟规则判断,再给出备份流程。

say.text: GitHub Actions 构建失败时推 Discord 通知我。
say.note: 它会建议用 Webhook 触发器,并提醒先测试。

say.text: 每周五下午汇总本周任务发到 #progress 频道。
say.note: 它会安排定时任务,并提示配置 API 凭据。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude helps you build n8n automations: it judges if a task is worth automating, gives a simple workflow design, and reminds you to use the credential system, test first, and export JSON backups.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask to automate repetitive processes, set notifications, or schedule backups, etc. It may also suggest a workflow when you do a manual task you'll repeat.

say_en.text: Set up a daily MinIO backup of my game project at 2am.
say_en.note: It applies the 5-minute rule and proposes a backup workflow.

say_en.text: Notify me on Discord when a GitHub Actions build fails.
say_en.note: It suggests a webhook trigger and reminds you to test first.

say_en.text: Every Friday, post this week's task summary to #progress.
say_en.note: It schedules the trigger and prompts for API credentials.
